preconditions.description: The input word must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(dict_scores.get(char.upper(), 0) for char in word if char.isalpha())
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of Scrabble scores for all alphabetic characters in the input string, using the preloaded dict_scores dictionary and ignoring non-alphabetic characters like spaces.
